title: One copper primary holds in Classes' error state and through Live queue retries
acceptance: When the class library fails to load, Classes shows one copper primary (the recovery action or Create, not both).
A per-card readiness Retry in the Live queue does not drop or move the copper action while that card refetches.
A decision is recorded on whether the Live queue's copper goes to the first runnable class (Preflight) when the leading card only offers a fix action.

evidence.summary: Final review of #673 on 60bff17, logged, not blocking: the Classes library-error state renders two copper buttons; a Live queue card Retry makes allResolved false so copper drops and may move; copper can land on a fix verb while a runnable class sits lower.
Owner pre-approved RF-163 items 1-2 for the 2026-11-05 unattended Neo session; item 3 stays an owner decision.

Neo local: item 1 was already met on main 827ae64 (the library-error state renders only 'Try the library again' in copper; + Create lives in the library view); a new test pins it. Item 2: the new Live queue retry test failed on main (copper dropped to none while a card refetched) and passes with the fix; Dashboard.test.tsx all pass. A fresh-context review found the leading card (one class, or every check failed) still lost its copper Retry while refetching; fixed by keeping the same button as a busy copper "Checking…" (it keeps keyboard focus). Its new test failed on the earlier commit and passes now; Dashboard.test.tsx 221 passed.
RF-163 items 1-2 PR, opened under unattended pre-approval issue #730 after two fresh-context /code-review high passes (the significant finding fixed; follow-ups in RF-201).

Owner decision on item 3 (live Neo session, 2026-11-05): keep the Live queue copper on the leading card, including when that card only offers a fix; it does not move to the first runnable class. Main already does this (LiveQueue renders primary={allResolved && index === 0}), so no code change is needed.

resolution: Items 1-2 shipped in #734 (Classes library-error state holds one copper; a Live queue card Retry keeps the copper in place as a busy "Checking…"). Item 3: the owner decided the copper stays on the leading card even when it only offers a fix, which is main's existing behavior, so nothing further ships. Follow-ups in RF-201.
